svg.title: Tabsdown 1.6.0 — Markdown tabs for Obsidian
svg.desc: A modular poster demonstrates marker and fenced syntax, tabs nested inside an active tab, adding and styling tab layouts, and editing Markdown directly inside a tab.
svg.metadata: Original editable SVG geometry adapted from the user-approved Colsdown release poster. Embedded Geist regular and bold are licensed under the SIL Open Font License. Origin: tabsdown-v1.6-release.json.
